An added entry goes into the shared l_hostLC / l_countLC pair (defined in w7_global_04.cpp, declared in w7_global_04.hpp), the single pair the binary reaches through l_hostLC_ptr and l_countLC_ptr. Entries are host hostent values; the listing's 32-bit 0x14-byte allocation becomes new hostent{}. The request is read at the 32-bit layout (busy-flag pointer at byte offset 0, host name at byte offset 4), which is not host-correct until a request struct is declared. LC_DEBUG_OUT (0x89c304) is a bare-return stub in the binary, so its call is kept with no arguments. LC_API_STRNEW (0x89d31c) is DupCString. GetHostIP (0x89f9a0), GetHostByName (0x89fb04) and Startup (0x89feec) read the binary's pair, but net-transport/src/lc_android_socket.cpp keeps its own anonymous-namespace l_hostLC / l_countLC and a duplicate of this function, so those readers do not see these entries until that file uses the core-platform pair. Not covered by a test (network lookup).
